words.definition: v. to leave someone or something behind
n. the power or skill to do something
adv. in or to a foreign country
n. the state of being away from a place
v. to take in a liquid, gas or other substance
adj. existing as an idea, not as a physical thing
adj. relating to education and scholarship
n. a way of pronouncing the words of a language
n. the right or opportunity to use or benefit from something
